propositions: CLI --timeout and --timeout-method flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes permanently shadow ini configuration changes because the workflow comes from trusted main while patchsets carry the ini, breaking self-verification of timeout budget fixes.
pytest-timeout precedence resolves CLI flags before ini values, making any patchset modification to pyproject.toml's timeout budget invisible to its own Verified gate run until the flags are removed.

Removing --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread from both shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) and governing via [tool.pytest.ini_options] alone preserves effective budget while enabling ini changes to be tested by their own CI run.
The conftest-floor hardening approach is rejected because pytest-timeout reads config._env_timeout read-only at session start with no supported hook point and lacks OSS precedent.

Parity contracts must be rewritten to assert shared-tier lanes carry no --timeout/--timeout-method flags and that the ini carries timeout>0 with thread method, while other eleven calibrated CI lanes retain explicit flags.
